ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity predominance with an estimated 90:10 ratio of white (high-intensity) to black (low-intensity) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black border along the trailing edge and distal tips; a distinctive vertical black linear mark originating at the median notch and extending inferiorly; a single isolated circular black focal spot located in the center-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 90-degree V-shaped angular depression with high-depth penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes; more pronounced jagged peaks on the left lobe trailing edge compared to more uniform micro-serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, low-contrast circular indentations (pockmarks) scattered across the white surface; one high-contrast black circular focal spot on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel diagonal linear disruptions of lower intensity (grey/brown) visible on the left lobe ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation or notch on the terminal point of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and spray artifacts along the inferior boundary where the fluke meets the water line.
